authority: Latest user instruction: 继续改啊，直到达到目标才能停. Continue genuinely distinct evidence-supported implementation; unchanged historical contracts and failures are never reset or promoted.
question: Does simultaneous allocation of original qualified additions improve the actual account relative to sequential funding, without enlarging any aggregate capital or protection authority?
basis: Observed prior rank changes yield offsetting wealth changes across pools; settled campaign payoff also rejects. The unchanged support allocator spends actual residual cash/risk sequentially, gives eligible held legs first access to all residual risk, and completes new orders in a separate sequential pass. This couples who gets funded to ordering and sizing. It is not proof of available profit; the current experiment changes funding geometry rather than another forecast, gate or nearby model setting.
control: Exact observed_admission_completion Owner and Config, independently measured at the same source/runtime/data as treatment.

treatment.qualified_set: Original ready/entry/exit/readmission rules, positive original score, and original held-addition fresh-breakout rule. Held inventory occupies its actual slots. Admit no more than original remaining slots; candidates use original descending score and symbol tie-break, not learned scores.
treatment.resources: Only min(.99*actual_cash, risk_cap*NAV-actual_holdings_value), nonnegative original aggregate stop-risk room, and unchanged single-name/sector notional headrooms. Same live/pending/admission stops and max(price-stop,.02*price) distances. No provisional sale proceeds, extra positions or looser protection.
treatment.joint_allocation: Starting from zero additions, progressively increase candidate notionals along original_positive_score/stop_risk_density. Advance only until the first cash/risk/symbol/sector resource binds; freeze all legs consuming a binding resource, continue the remaining legs. Thus unconstrained downside-risk additions share the original score proportions, without a new fit or tuning parameter. Preserve global .10 modeled stop-risk budget and all original Config values. This replaces the original initial per-new-leg split and separate fresh-completion pass as one newly declared sizing mechanism, not an equivalence claim.
treatment.materiality: Original minimum additions remain .08*NAV for held legs and .01*NAV for new legs. Drop the lowest-priority below-minimum active leg and recompute from the original resources; when a dropped new leg frees a slot, consider the next originally eligible name. Each drop is permanent for that close, so the finite loop terminates in at most the number of eligible names plus one. Never leave a sub-material request or create a new eligibility exception.
treatment.holding_and_protection: All previously held units are retained unless the original parent requires reduction. The existing complete parent handles individual exits, concentration cuts, total cap changes, economic reduction latch and rounding. Joint funding is reached only after original protection is satisfied; it cannot offset or revoke any pending sale. It updates pending support only for actual positive requests. No ordinary swap or named-stock branch.
treatment.observation: Record resource capacities, joint additions, selected original indices, modeled stop risk, and whether held/fresh candidates competed. These are requested allocations, not executions or free-profit counterfactuals. Actual-account attribution remains the economic check.

screen: Reuse unchanged research.decision_review.paired_screen: union/common-five/joint optical-leader removal control+treatment through 2025-12-31, each wealth nondecreasing and MDD nonincreasing and some strict improvement. measurement_scope: Exactly one fixed paired mechanism, no grids. If rejected, no neighboring weighting/slot/risk parameters or treatment-2026 replay. Failure permits diagnosis and a substantively different prospective mechanism only under latest user authority, not an automatic budget reset.
advance: Only a passing paired treatment advances unchanged to full history and both original 2026 crash windows. Preserve final reference/removal/subset/cost/delay/prefix requirements before any main merge.
